$comment: A seeded revision pair for change detection (PRD 4.2). Two listings from the same
connector, a month apart, exercising all four outcomes at once: one source is edited,
one disappears, one is new, and two are untouched.
Sources carry their text rather than a content hash. A hand-written hash in a fixture is
an unverifiable constant — nobody can tell a correct one from a typo, and the test that
reads it would agree with either. The test hashes the text with the same function the
store uses, so the fixture states the input and the code derives the identity.
